title: Cut-and-Come-Again Lettuce Method Explained Step-by-Step
reason: This video explains the cut-and-come-again method for growing lettuce and answers related questions about plant maintenance.

tasks.task: Demonstrate the cut-and-come-again method for growing lettuce.

subtasks.text: Show the process of carefully removing large mature leaves to preserve the growing crown.
Illustrate how to use a chef's knife to slice off outer leaves while preserving the crown.

tasks.task: Explain the two different methods of applying the cut-and-come-again technique.

subtasks.text: Describe the first method, which involves cutting away outer leaves by hand.
Describe the second method, which uses a knife to more efficiently remove outer leaves.

tasks.task: Address common questions about the method, specifically regarding the number of times the plant can be cut.

subtasks.text: Present the general range of cuts that can be made before the lettuce plant degrades.
